workload.operator: Y=(Q K^T)V; no softmax and no normalization

basis: triangle inequality for T products with |score|<=1 and |V|<=1

quantization.full_scale_semantics: maximum representable magnitude; count |x| > full_scale before clipping
quantization.calibration: any empirical calibration requires a new protocol revision and frozen calibration set

noise_modes.shared: one noisy encoded operand per tensor element, reused across fan-out; correlated encoding error assumption
noise_modes.per_use: independent encoding noise at every modeled product use; contrast assumption, not hardware characterization
noise_modes.detector_noise: applied at declared modeled detection boundary; no calibrated device noise included

evidence.cpu_latency_quality: measured only for the recorded Python/NumPy implementation on the named host

non_claims: Operation counts are not energy estimates
